title: Accelerated Benefit Rider Terms: Terminal Illness Advance on Whole Life Insurance
content:
**Benefit.** An insured under an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy who is certified to have a life expectancy of the tier's qualifying months or less may receive part of the death benefit in advance, once per policy.

**Status.** An acceleration is paid only while the policy status is in force, paid-up or reduced paid-up, as the system record of that policy shows.

**Approval.** An advance is paid only under an accelerated benefit claim whose request status is approved, which requires the written consent of every irrevocable beneficiary and assignee. The certified life expectancy is the one recorded on that claim.

**Largest election.** The elected amount may not exceed the lower of:

- the tier's largest share of the face amount, applied to the base face amount, less the loan balance; and
- the tier's largest acceleration on one insured, less the acceleration advances already paid on the same insured across all Ashgrove whole life policies.

**Amount paid.** The amount paid is the elected amount reduced by the tier's actuarial discount and then by the tier's processing fee, rounded to the cent.

**Lien.** The lien is the elected amount; it bears no interest and is deducted from the death proceeds. Premiums and dividends continue on the full face.

## Worked advance (hypothetical 20-Pay policy: largest share 80%, largest acceleration 500000, discount 6.5%, fee 150.00)

Base face 200000.00, loan balance 20000.00, advances already paid on the insured under another Ashgrove whole life policy 400000.00.

1. 80% of 200000.00 is 160000.00; less the loan, 140000.00.
2. 500000.00 less 400000.00 is 100000.00.
3. The largest election is the lower: 100000.00.
4. Electing 100000.00: reduced by 6.5% gives 93500.00; less the 150.00 fee, the advance paid is 93350.00. The lien is 100000.00.
